class.name: DisIffPdu
class.brief_description: IFF PDU (type 28): an IFF or secondary surveillance radar transponder or interrogator.
class.description: An IFF PDU reports the state of an identification system carried by an entity: system type, name and mode, its status and the code of each mode (Mode 1, 2, 3/A, 4, C and 5/S). It is 60 bytes for layer 1 plus any further layers, and has protocol family 6 (Distributed Emission Regeneration). Layer 1 is decoded into properties: the System ID record ([member system_type], [member system_name], [member system_mode], [member change_options]), [member system_designator], [member system_specific_data] and the fundamental operational data ([member system_status], [member data_field_1], [member information_layers], [member data_field_2], [member parameters]). Layers 2 and up (Mode 5, Mode S and others) are kept raw in [member layers]. godot-dis encodes and decodes the PDU; it does not model IFF interrogation. The PDU is encoded with godot-dis's own code.

link.title: Emissions: radars, jammers, designators and IFF

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as an IFF PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid IFF PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], fewer than 60 bytes, or a further layer whose length field is smaller than 4 or runs past the PDU length). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size.

members.member: Change/Options bit field of the System ID record (8-bit).
Alternate parameter 4 of the fundamental operational data (8-bit).
Modifier of the fundamental operational data (8-bit).
ID of the entity that carries the IFF system, as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).
Event ID as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = event number).
Bit field of the information layers that are present or active (8-bit), part of the fundamental operational data.

Further layers (layer 2 and up) as an [Array] of [PackedByteArray], kept raw. Each entry is a whole layer including its 4-byte layer header: layer number (1 byte), layer specific information (1 byte) and the layer length in bytes (16-bit, header included). Each entry must be at least 4 and at most 65535 bytes for [method DisPduBase.encode].

The six 16-bit parameters of the fundamental operational data, in order: Mode 1, Mode 2, Mode 3/A, Mode 4, Mode C, Mode 5 / S. Setting an array that does not have exactly 6 values prints an error and leaves the old value.
Location of the antenna relative to the entity, as a [Vector3] in metres in the entity's body axes (32-bit floats on the wire).
System designator (8-bit): tells apart several IFF systems of the same type on one entity.
Operating mode of the system (8-bit, SISO-REF-010 "IFF System Mode"), part of the System ID record.
System name (16-bit, SISO-REF-010 "IFF System Name"), part of the System ID record.
System status bit field (8-bit), part of the fundamental operational data: operational flag, system on/off, parameters 1-6 available or not.
System type (16-bit, SISO-REF-010 "IFF System Type": transponder, interrogator, ...), part of the System ID record.
